description: Universal Tool- and Model-Agnostic Verification Evidence Contract. All verifiers (deterministic scripts, Codex, Claude, local models) must adhere to this schema.

evidence_command.description: Literal machine command executed to collect empirical proof

command_output.description: Verbatim stdout and stderr resulting from the evidence command

exit_code.description: Process exit return code (0 for success, non-zero for failure)

rules.no_prose_pass: AI verifiers are strictly prohibited from declaring VERIFIED using conversational prose without populated evidence fields and exit_code=0.
rules.deterministic_precedence: Layer 1 deterministic tests cannot be superseded or waived by any AI model verdict.
rules.all_or_nothing: Any failed vector immediately forces overall verdict to FAILED.
